name: Wizard Specialization
description: A wizard may specialize in one school of magic, gaining focus in it at the cost of giving up others. Specializing is optional — a wizard who takes no specialty is a universalist, keeps every school, and prohibits none. Chosen at 1st wizard level and never changed. Universal spells belong to no school and can never be given up.

options.name: Abjuration
options.description: Protective spells: wards, barriers and dispelling.

options.name: Evocation
options.description: Manipulating energy to create damage or effects from nothing.

options.name: Illusion
options.description: Deceiving the senses or the mind.

options.name: Necromancy
options.description: Manipulating life force and the undead.

options.name: Transmutation
options.description: Changing the properties of a creature, object or condition.

name: Prohibited Schools
description: The schools a specialist wizard gives up. Spells of a prohibited school can never be learned, written into the spellbook or cast. A specialist gives up two schools, except a diviner, who gives up only one. A wizard with no specialty prohibits nothing.
